description: This PHP source file defines the DefaultTimesheetAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving the default timesheet for a specific employee, optionally filtered by date. It is part of the OrangeHRM Time plugin API and handles CRUD operations related to timesheets, with only the 'getOne' method implemented.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching the default timesheet, optionally filtered by date and employee number. Implements methods for retrieving timesheet data and validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the default timesheet for the specified employee and date filter.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'date' query parameter as a DateTime object, if provided.

methods.name: getEmpNumberParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for 'empNumber' parameter, restricting access to permitted employee numbers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method, including optional date parameter.
